test.name: A plain research request proceeds without pausing
test.description: Continuous work is unconditional since research-as-a-job S2: the --autonomous flag that used to gate it is gone from every body. What it gated is now the default, so this grades the ordinary request. Keeping the flag in the message would grade a trigger no body declares any more.

judge_context: The research orchestrator triggers on an ordinary research request; there is no mode flag
Should proceed without pausing for clarifying questions — continuous work is the default, and stopping to ask is a stall
